description: This file defines a ThemeStore class managing theme settings (dark/light, system follow) for the Notesnook application, including theme initialization, switching, and desktop theme updates.

classes.name: ThemeStore
classes.description: A class extending BaseStore to manage theme-related state and actions such as toggling themes, setting color schemes, and syncing with desktop environment.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the theme by applying current theme settings and updating themes asynchronously.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets a new theme, updates desktop background, and saves to config.

methods.name: setColorScheme
methods.description: Changes the color scheme (dark/light), updates theme, and saves to config.

methods.name: toggleColorScheme
methods.description: Switches between dark and light themes.

methods.name: setFollowSystemTheme
methods.description: Enables or disables following the system theme and updates desktop accordingly.

methods.name: toggleFollowSystemTheme
methods.description: Toggles the follow system theme setting.

methods.name: isThemeCurrentlyApplied
methods.description: Checks if a theme with a given ID is currently active.
